picks.name: Chore Jacket, putty
picks.why: You still own no utility jacket, and this UK-made, logo-free cotton chore coat is 70% off with L in stock. Putty sits in the stone family, so it works tonally over navy or olive. Layer it over the navy raglan with jeans and trainers for photography walks.

picks.name: Byrne Chelsea Boot, dark brown leather
picks.why: Exactly the sleek office Chelsea you wanted: a slimmer last than your Docs, leather-lined, with a Vibram sole that grips on wet Bangor pavements. It's £120, down from £280, with UK 10 in stock. Wear it with chinos or smart trousers and a knit for the office.

picks.name: Long Fit Raglan Sweatshirt, navy
picks.why: Fills the empty mid-layer slot. The raglan sleeve gives your long arms more reach, and the longer body covers the midsection without bagging. Plain navy loopback at £52 (was £65): wear it under the chore jacket or with chinos at the weekend.
